title: Marked-Poisson Collision Experiment for ATE with High-Cardinality Known Strata Masses
banked_reason: D0.5.G graded the sound finite-profile orbit experiment incremental (paper_score_ceiling 5.7 < field threshold 7.4); a matching full-class estimator and exact critical constant over Zeng H_d(1/4) are unsupported.
gap_reasons: The note proves a substantive finite-profile Le Cam limit and an exact Bayes/minimax constant only for a specially constructed two-point deterministic-sign orbit with known masses and named macroscopic cells.

For the published homogeneous-ATE class, it delivers solely a supervised uniform lower bound; it supplies neither a matching estimator nor a full-class exact constant, and the honest-interval result is likewise a nonattained lower bound.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery constructed and math-reviewed a two-way finite-profile marked-Poisson experiment, an exact orbit minimax value, certified finite enumeration, strict auxiliary-record gain, and an honest-length lower bound. The field-tier attempt stopped at D0.5 because the exact value applies to a two-point sign orbit; the published homogeneous class receives only a lower bound. A matching full-class estimator and exact critical constant remain unproved, and no Lean formalization began.
tldr: Known high-cardinality masses with finitely many order-\(1/n\) strata yield a two-way finite-profile experiment: shared-sign macroscopic Poisson clusters plus diffuse labeled--labeled and labeled--unlabeled marked-Poisson channels. Its deterministic-sign orbit risk transfers with an explicit finite-sample error, admits a finite enumeration with a certified Poisson-tail remainder, and at \(t=1/8\), \(\gamma_{\mathrm{diff}}=\rho=1\) lies strictly between \(0.015334312667495\) and \(0.015334314123434\). Auxiliary intensity strictly lowers this risk when \(\gamma_{\mathrm{diff}}>0\), while honest all-table intervals obey the positive no-informative-point length lower bound. The uniform supervised embedding into the published exact-homogeneity class remains a lower-bound-only converse.
gap: ZengBalakrishnanHanKennedy2024 identifies collision-driven difficulty for the uniform exact-homogeneity ATE class, while unequal-occupancy sources provide generic Poisson approximations. Those results do not determine the causal limit experiment when a known mass array contains finitely many cells with expected occupancy of constant order. The prior one-heavy-cell boundary also did not classify several interacting common strata or identify the exact zero-profile endpoint.
fill: The project derives a two-way cluster-product plus diffuse experiment comparison with a quantitative error budget, records exact recovery of the pair-only experiment as the immediate \(J=0\) corollary of the finite-profile theorem, and supplies positive observable separation for every nonempty profile. The deterministic-sign orbit risk and its absolutely convergent posterior-variance series are downstream corollaries rather than the headline.
